note: Candidates found during the 2026-08-16 verify pass (Italy MASAF national monumental-trees register, 19 candidates within the comune) that did not ship this pass. Kept because the platform's direction is to map every remarkable tree eventually. Never rendered: these are leads, not entries. Four trees shipped to data/research/sorrento-verified.json (Villa Fondi holm oak and stone pine, the cemetery cypress, the Via Maresca plane), all in Piano di Sorrento / Sant'Agnello, which adjoin Sorrento on the peninsula.

leads.name: Pino domestico of Via Bagnulo
leads.why: MASAF sheet 11/G568/NA/15 (via scheda_44 on agricoltura.regione.campania.it, directly fetched and confirmed as a genuine dedicated card, not a search summary): girth 336cm, height 20m, umbrella-shaped stone pine 'ben visibile da piu strade del luogo' (well visible from several streets), a public street tree rather than a private-address one (no house number given, unlike the Cedro dell'Himalaya and other blocked candidate below). Held back purely on the alive-now test, not on access or the collectible-point test, both of which it otherwise passes: Positanonews reported a branch failure on this same street in June 2020 ('un grosso ramo si stacca dal pino'), AND a second, much more serious Positanonews article dated 2026-08-12 ('tragedia sfiorata in Via Bagnulo: albero crolla in strada... sfiorando due ragazze') reports a large tree collapsing onto the road on Via Bagnulo two and a half weeks before this pass, injuring nobody by luck. WebFetch on the second article could not confirm species or exact address ('un grosso albero', no botanical ID), so it is not established whether this is the same registered pine or a different street tree. This needs a fresh, targeted check before shipping: search Positanonews and local Facebook/Instagram groups for photos of the Aug 2026 incident site, or check whether Via Bagnulo's monumental pine (google-mappable via the scheda's embedded map) still stands. Do not ship this tree without resolving that.

leads.name: Homogeneous olive group, Riviera Massa
leads.species: Olea europaea (register entry: 'Insieme omogeneo di Olea europaea', i.e. a group, not a single tree)
leads.why: MASAF register entry (sheet 01/I862/NA/15) explicitly describes this as a homogeneous GROUP of olives, no girth or height given for an individual tree, no single specimen distinguished. Fails the collectible-point test (one identifiable tree, or a compact famous ensemble with one obvious place to stand) as recorded; a future pass could check whether local sources single out one specific old olive within the group, which would change this from blocked to leads-with-a-candidate. Coordinates sit close to the Grand Hotel Parco dei Principi grounds (see blocked entry below), so access would need the same check regardless.

blocked.name: Roverella, Tasso and Tiglio of the Antico Parco del Principe (Colli di San Pietro)
blocked.reason: RESOLVED this pass, moved from leads to blocked. All three at Via Cermenna 12, Piano di Sorrento, ~4.7km from Sorrento centre (already past or at the edge of the 30-minute day-trip boundary on its own). Confirmed via two independent sources each: MASAF register plus dedicated Regione Campania schede (scheda_41 Tilia platyphyllos girth 365cm, scheda_42 Quercus pubescens girth 495cm, both directly fetched; a scheda for the yew/tasso was searched for but not located by number, though scheda_43 'il Tasso del Parco del Principe' was seen in a search result and is presumed to exist). Access is now settled rather than merely suspected: the site trades today as 'Hotel & Resort Antico Parco del Principe', a wedding/event venue and hotel with trekking paths, stables, tennis, two pools and rooms for hire (confirmed via the hotel's own trivago/trip.com/superdossier listings), i.e. a reservation-and-reception-desk property, not a walk-in park. Fails hard rule 10's first test outright. Do not re-research; if a future pass finds evidence of a public path through the grounds or open days, reconsider.

blocked.name: Cedro dell'Himalaya, Via Carlo Amalfi 15
blocked.reason: MASAF sheet 12/G568/NA/15, girth 359cm, height 18m (via scheda_45 on agricoltura.regione.campania.it, directly fetched). The register's own description places it 'nella corte del complesso scolastico ad oggi dismesso, ma oggetto di un prossimo progetto di ristrutturazione' (in the courtyard of a school complex now DISABLED/abandoned and awaiting a future restructuring project). An abandoned school courtyard is not open ground under hard rule 10's school exception, which requires evidence the site is genuinely open (a through-path, weekend hours); an abandoned, fenced building under a future redevelopment plan is the opposite of that. Blocked; reconsider only if the restructuring project reopens the site with public access, or if a future pass finds it is actually viewable/reachable from the public street outside the courtyard wall.

blocked.name: Platano comune, Grand Hotel Parco dei Principi grounds
blocked.reason: Access: the hotel's own botanical garden page states the garden is accessible to hotel guests and to patrons of its restaurants (Gio Ponti, Poggio Siracusa) and the Blu Bar, plus occasional FAI (Fondo Ambiente Italiano) open-day events; it is not a garden with ordinary walk-in or paid-ticket public access. That fails hard rule 10's first test (can a visitor get in without asking anyone's permission, e.g. a reception desk, a reservation, a guard). Girth 405cm, height 31.5m, MASAF sheet 03/I862/NA/15. If future evidence shows genuine unrestricted or simple paid public access (a garden ticket, regular open hours), this and its three companions below should be reconsidered.

blocked.name: Agathis robusta (kauri pine), Grand Hotel Parco dei Principi grounds
blocked.reason: Same access finding as the Platano comune above: hotel-guest/restaurant-patron access plus occasional FAI open days, not genuine public access. Described by the hotel's own site as among the first kauri pine specimens planted in Italy, girth 300cm, height 30m, MASAF sheet 02/I862/NA/15.

blocked.name: Ginkgo biloba, Grand Hotel Parco dei Principi grounds
blocked.reason: Same access finding as above. Girth 402cm, height 25m, MASAF sheet 02/I208/NA/15 (register lists this parcel under Sant'Agnello rather than Sorrento, still the same hotel grounds).

blocked.name: Cinnamomum camphora (camphor tree), Grand Hotel Parco dei Principi grounds
blocked.reason: Same access finding as above. Girth 444cm, height 24m, MASAF sheet 01/I208/NA/15 (register lists this parcel under Sant'Agnello rather than Sorrento, still the same hotel grounds).
